# HTML&HTML

> HTML&HTML is an evidence-first AI Website Readiness platform. One canonical 12-engine public scan core powers focused tools, sourced guidance, a $149 implementation-grade Fix Mandate and an access-gated AI Mention Tracker. Evidence is free; implementation precision is the paid product.

## Language hubs
- [English hub](https://htmlandhtml.com/en): Global default product and tool directory.
- [Türkçe ana sayfa](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr): Tam Türkçe ürün, araç ve rehber yapısı.

## Directory hubs
- [English tools](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/tools): Focused diagnostic entry points backed by the canonical 12-engine scan core.
- [Türkçe araçlar](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/araclar): Canonical 12-motor çekirdeği kullanan odaklı araç girişleri.
- [English guides](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/guides): Sourced decision-support guides linked to measurable tools.
- [Türkçe rehberler](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/rehberler): Ölçülebilir araçlara bağlanan kaynaklı karar destek rehberleri.

## Focused tools — English
- [Website Scanner](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/website-scanner): Broad 12-engine public website diagnosis across crawl, technical SEO, AI access, llms.txt, schema, performance hygiene, accessibility, security, trust, agent readiness, conversion and links.
- [AI Website Readiness](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/ai-website-readiness): Full AI and technical readiness view across all 12 engines.
- [llms.txt Validator](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/llms-txt-validator): llms.txt structure, discovery and real-link evidence.
- [AI Crawler Checker](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/ai-crawler-checker): Crawler-policy and access checks for AI/search retrieval surfaces.
- [Schema Validator](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/schema-validator): Parse JSON-LD and surface broken structured-data blocks without claiming that schema guarantees rankings or AI citations.
- [Technical SEO Checker](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/technical-seo-checker): Check crawlability, redirects, titles, meta, H1, canonicals, duplicates and route-level technical signals.
- [Security Headers Checker](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/security-headers-checker): Inspect HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, nosniff, Referrer Policy, Permissions Policy and mixed-content signals.
- [Accessibility Checker](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/accessibility-checker): Check public HTML signals such as lang, alt text, programmatic form labels and accessible names.
- [Link Integrity Checker](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/link-integrity-checker): Probe internal links for broken destinations and avoidable redirects with real HTTP requests.
- [AI Mention Tracker](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/ai-mention-tracker): Paid neutral-prompt measurement across configured AI search API surfaces.

## Odaklı araçlar — Türkçe
- [Site Tarama](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/site-tarama): Crawl, teknik SEO, AI erişimi, llms.txt, schema, performans hijyeni, erişilebilirlik, güvenlik, güven, agent hazırlığı, dönüşüm ve linkler için 12 motorlu public site teşhisi.
- [AI Web Sitesi Hazırlığı](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/ai-website-readiness): 12 motorun tamamında AI ve teknik hazırlık görünümü.
- [llms.txt Doğrulayıcı](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/llms-txt-validator): llms.txt yapı, keşif ve gerçek link kanıtı.
- [AI Tarayıcı Kontrolü](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/ai-crawler-checker): AI ve arama retrieval yüzeyleri için bot-politika ve erişim kontrolleri.
- [Schema Doğrulayıcı](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/schema-validator): JSON-LD parse durumunu ve bozuk yapısal veri bloklarını kontrol eder; schema kullanımını sıralama veya AI citation garantisi gibi sunmaz.
- [Teknik SEO Kontrolü](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/teknik-seo-kontrol): Crawl erişimi, redirect, title, meta, H1, canonical, duplicate ve route-level teknik sinyalleri kontrol eder.
- [Güvenlik Başlıkları Kontrolü](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/guvenlik-basliklari-kontrol): HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, nosniff, Referrer Policy, Permissions Policy ve mixed-content sinyallerini kontrol eder.
- [Erişilebilirlik Kontrolü](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/erisilebilirlik-kontrol): Lang, alt text, programatik form label ve accessible-name gibi public HTML sinyallerini kontrol eder.
- [Link Bütünlüğü Kontrolü](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/link-kontrol): İç linkleri gerçek HTTP istekleriyle kırık hedef ve gereksiz redirect açısından ölçer.
- [AI Marka Görünürlük Takibi](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/ai-mention-tracker): Yapılandırılmış AI arama API yüzeylerinde ücretli, tarafsız-prompt ölçümü.

## Guides — English
- [AI Website Readiness Checklist: A Technical Evidence-First Framework](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/guides/ai-website-readiness-checklist): A practical checklist for crawl access, technical SEO, AI crawler policy, llms.txt, structured data, accessibility, security, trust and links without treating any one signal as a ranking guarantee.
- [llms.txt: What It Is, What It Is Not, and How to Validate It](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/guides/llms-txt): A sourced guide to llms.txt v2, discovery relationships, link reachability and the limits of the proposal.
- [AI Crawler Access: Robots.txt, Search Retrieval and Vendor-Specific Controls](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/guides/ai-crawler-access): A vendor-sourced guide to separating search crawlers, user-directed retrieval and model-development collection controls.
- [Structured Data for AI Readiness: What You Can Validate Reliably](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/guides/structured-data-for-ai): How to use structured data as a measurable semantic layer without turning it into an AI citation promise.
- [AI Search Visibility: From Crawl Eligibility to Measured Mentions](https://htmlandhtml.com/en/guides/ai-search-visibility): A practical model for separating technical eligibility, retrieval evidence and neutral-prompt mention measurement.

## Rehberler — Türkçe
- [AI Web Sitesi Hazırlık Kontrol Listesi: Kanıt Öncelikli Teknik Çerçeve](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/rehberler/ai-web-sitesi-hazirlik-kontrol-listesi): Crawl erişimi, teknik SEO, AI crawler politikası, llms.txt, yapısal veri, erişilebilirlik, güvenlik, güven ve linkleri tek bir sinyali ranking garantisi gibi sunmadan değerlendiren pratik kontrol listesi.
- [llms.txt Nedir, Ne Değildir ve Nasıl Doğrulanır?](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/rehberler/llms-txt): llms.txt v2, discovery ilişkileri, link erişilebilirliği ve proposal sınırlarını kaynaklı biçimde açıklayan rehber.
- [AI Tarayıcı Erişimi: robots.txt, Arama Retrieval ve Vendor Kontrolleri](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/rehberler/ai-tarayici-erisimi): Arama crawler’ları, kullanıcı yönlendirmeli retrieval ve model-geliştirme veri toplama kontrollerini birbirinden ayıran vendor kaynaklı rehber.
- [AI Hazırlığı İçin Yapısal Veri: Güvenilir Biçimde Ne Ölçülebilir?](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/rehberler/ai-icin-yapisal-veri): Structured data’yı AI citation vaadine dönüştürmeden ölçülebilir semantik katman olarak kullanma rehberi.
- [AI Arama Görünürlüğü: Crawl Uygunluğundan Ölçülmüş Mention’a](https://htmlandhtml.com/tr/rehberler/ai-arama-gorunurlugu): Teknik uygunluk, retrieval kanıtı ve tarafsız-prompt mention ölçümünü birbirinden ayıran pratik model.

## Scan boundaries
- Up to 50 public HTML pages and 30 link probes per scan.
- Private/local/reserved targets, credential-bearing URLs, non-standard ports and redirect pivots into private address space fail closed.
- Unknown or unavailable measurements are excluded from the relevant score denominator rather than forced to pass or fail.
- Reliable LCP, INP and CLS remain NOT_MEASURED without appropriate field/lab integration.
- Public scanning does not invent source-file paths. File-level targeting requires source/codebase context.
- A score is not a guarantee of rankings, traffic, revenue or AI citations.
- llms.txt is treated as a PROPOSAL, not a mandatory web standard.
